Is there a reason to have the `@` in here, or did that get copied from the example configuration?

Also, please insert a space at the end of the format string--otherwise subsequent modules get screwed up

```suggestion
            format: "[$localip]($style) ",

This panics for me as soon as I disconnect my internet.

```
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at 'called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value', src/modules/localip.rs:25:42
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
```

I don't 100% remember the semantics we have for this kind of stuff, but I think `log::warn!` will warn once per prompt draw, so anyone working with their internet disconnected will see this warning every time starship does a draw. It might be better to demote this to an `info!` log so that it doesn't spam when working offline.
